explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 26 configurations over 6 sweeps (topology-pp, batch-caps, kv-capacity, moe-collective, prefill-chunking, cudagraph), each at 5 load levels, every run on exactly 8 GPUs.

1x TP4xPP2 + EP, from the prefill-chunking sweep, reached 25.15 tok/s/accelerator (201.2 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 8 while holding the scenario's SLOs. Ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs.
1x TP4xPP2 + EP at concurrency 8. 6 of 130 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path

recommendation_prose: The table below lists the measured operating points. Headline ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs. The Pareto front of every sweep is in pareto.json.

prose: TP8 should peak highest, since every pipeline stage adds a boundary hop to each decode step.
Measured: no configuration in this sweep held the SLOs at any tested load.

prose: fp8 KV and higher memory utilization should substitute on TP8.
Measured: best was 1x TP8 + EP (KV dtype fp8) at 15.91 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 4).

prose: DeepEP low-latency should win on TP8.
